The petitioner. a practicing Advocate of Netrokona Bar and a Bangladeshi National by birth, obtained a power of attorney on 16.4.92 from his I'm sons who are all residents of India in respect of some property in Bangladesh. The power of Attorney was authenticated by a Notary Public of West Bengal and the petitioner applied for re-stamping of the power of attorney within 3 months as required under section 18 of the stamp Act which was rejected by an order dated 6.1.93 by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue). Netrokona, directing further that the land covered by the power of attorney by made khas under section 92 of the state acquisition and Tenancy Act. 

 4. In respect of taking over of the property covered by the power of attorney as khas land the High Court Division observed that the aggrieved party may file an appeal under section 147 or may institute a suit under section 92(4) of the Stale Acquisition and Tenancy Act. As such equally efficacious remedy exists in respect of that portion of the order dated 6.1.93 passed by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Netrokona.
